FRONTEND: labour DAILY TALLY card -> /verify blind count (system pieces hidden pre-submit, verified), gallery photo upload (real file via file chooser) -> submit -> MATCHED banner with reveal; second task -> MISMATCH banner (system 5 vs physical 3, SUBMITTED). Admin VERIFICATION LOG tile -> /verifications: today rows, pending-review pill, history cards with system-vs-physical + status chips, photo loads (naturalWidth 400); APPLY STOCK CORRECTION via UI -> toast 'Stock corrected via OUT-20261002-0085' + card flips to CORRECTION APPLIED with correction entry link; UI assign flow (2 dropdowns + ASSIGN) replaced today's pending auto-picks and /verify shows ADMIN tags. Admin full-edit UI: block collapsed by default, toggle expands, vehicle+remarks+line pieces edit -> SAVE -> toast, persists after reload, EDIT HISTORY shows WAS->NOW incl. LINE_ITEMS rows. Inventory shows '✓ Verified <date> · <name>'. Office: read-only verifications (no assign block, no review buttons), no admin-edit-block. TWO bugs found & FIXED by tester: (1) CRITICAL red screen 'Rendered more hooks than during the previous render' on /entries — useState(reportOpen) placed AFTER the `if (!user) return <Redirect>` early return in app/entries.tsx:57; moved hook above the return, verified entries loads for office/admin. (2) HIGH Hindi Poppins never applied even after main agent's render-patch: FontDefaults set Text.__currentFont in useEffect, which fires AFTER the re-render triggered by the language toggle, leaving fonts stale by one render; moved the assignment into render body — measured computed fontFamily of Devanagari = 'Poppins' on login toggle AND fresh home mount. NOTE: tally mismatch alert emails fail in this environment (Resend 422 undeliverable recipient for @steeltrack.com test domain) — handled softly by design, submit unaffected.

minor.issue: When today's submitted/kept tasks already >= 2, assign silently inserts nothing but returns 200 — UI then toasts 'Today's tally items assigned' although nothing changed. Consider returning a warning/flag when 0 tasks were added.
apply_correction on a matched (0 discrepancy) verification silently becomes 'approved' — acceptable but undocumented edge.

ui_bugs.issue: RED SCREEN 'Rendered more hooks than during the previous render': const [reportOpen] = useState(false) was declared AFTER `if (!user) return <Redirect>` (line 57) — hooks-order violation crashed /entries whenever the screen mounted before auth context resolved. Moved the hook above the early return; verified /entries loads as office + admin. Reference: /app/frontend/app/entries.tsx:57

Main agent's React-19 render-patch for fonts was correct in mechanism (RNW 0.21 Text/TextInput are forwardRef objects with .render) but __currentFont was set inside useEffect, which runs after the lang-change re-render — Hindi text always rendered with the previous language's font (measured: system sans, never Poppins; double-toggle confirmed stale-by-one-render). Moved assignment into the component render body; measured computed fontFamily of Devanagari = 'Poppins' on toggle and on fresh screen mounts. Reference: /app/frontend/app/_layout.tsx:84-95

Tally photo button label reads 'TAKE PHOTO OF SLIP' (reuses take_photo i18n key) — for physical tally the photo is of counted stock, not a weighment slip. Needs a separate i18n string. Reference: /app/frontend/app/verify.tsx:184

rca_of_issue: BUG 1 (CRITICAL, fixed): app/entries.tsx declared useState(reportOpen) after the conditional `if (!user) return <Redirect/>`. When the screen mounted while auth context was still resolving (user=null), the first render ran 3 hooks and the next ran 4 -> React 'Rendered more hooks than during the previous render' red screen. Repro: login as office -> ENTRIES tile (or direct /entries with cold auth). Fix: moved the hook above the early return; audited all other screens — clean. BUG 2 (HIGH, fixed): FontDefaults set Text.__currentFont inside useEffect; the language toggle re-renders the tree BEFORE effects run, so every screen rendered with the previous language's font family forever (stale-by-one-render). Repro: tap lang-toggle, measure computed fontFamily of any Devanagari text -> system sans, never Poppins. Fix: assign during render body (FontDefaults renders before <Stack> children in the same pass). Verified 'Poppins' computed on toggle and fresh mounts. NON-BUG (environment): tally mismatch alert emails fail with Resend 422 undeliverable_recipient for @steeltrack.com — backend catches and logs (soft alert by design); submissions unaffected.
